metaDescription: Order custom medium sweaters and cardigans for your team. Perfect for uniforms, gifts, and events. Shop bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Medium is the most versatile size for corporate apparel, fitting the widest range of body types. Whether you're outfitting a sales team in Ladies' Sweater Blazers for client meetings or branding Men's Brooks Brothers® Merino V-Neck Sweaters for a company retreat, medium ensures a polished, professional look. Choose from open-front cardigans, hooded styles, or classic button-front designs for a cohesive uniform that works year-round.
